map.宠物疫苗驱虫提醒器 使用指南: Pet Vaccine and Deworming Reminder — User Guide
map.录入犬猫的疫苗与驱虫接种记录（品种、首免周龄、联苗与狂犬针次），工具依据免疫程序: Record cats' and dogs' vaccine and deworming history (breed, age at first dose, combination and rabies shots); the tool computes the next due date from the immunization schedule and reminds you before it falls due. Data is stored locally in the browser, with multi-pet management and history lookup.
map.幼犬/幼猫首免程序：犬 6–8 周起联苗，每 21 天一针共 3 针，3 个月后: Puppy/kitten primary schedule: dogs start the combination vaccine at 6–8 weeks, one shot every 21 days for 3 shots, with rabies added after 3 months; cats start the feline trivalent at 8 weeks similarly. The tool automatically computes each next due date from the recorded times.
map.年度加强：犬联苗、狂犬疫苗、猫三联均为每年（周期 365 天）加强一次，工具在临: Annual boosters: canine combination, rabies and feline trivalent are all boosted once a year (365-day cycle); the tool marks them 'due soon' within 7 days.
map.驱虫频率管理：体内驱虫每 90 天、体外驱虫/心丝虫预防每 30 天，多项目并行: Deworming frequency: internal deworming every 90 days, external/heartworm prevention every 30 days; with several items in parallel the tool summarizes 'due / due soon / normal' to avoid missing any.
map.算例：一只 2 岁犬的两项记录（基准日 2026-09-10）: Example: two records for a 2-year-old dog (base date 2026-09-10)
map.首次免疫程序怎么排？: How to schedule the primary immunization?
map.犬：6–8 周首针联苗，之后每 21–28 天一针至 16 周龄（不少于 3 针: Dogs: first combination shot at 6–8 weeks, then one every 21–28 days until 16 weeks of age (at least 3 shots), with rabies at 3 months; cats: first feline trivalent at 8 weeks, one every 3–4 weeks for 2–3 shots. Follow the vaccine label and local prevention requirements.
map.心丝虫经蚊叮咬传播，幼虫在体内移行约 6 个月才成虫，每月给药可阻断各阶段幼虫；: Heartworm spreads through mosquito bites, and larvae take about 6 months to mature; monthly dosing interrupts larvae at every stage; in southern or mosquito-active regions year-round prevention is advised. This tool is only a reminder—consult a physician before medication.
